_note: An AREAL family (the Sinosphere), not a genetic one: Sinitic (Chinese) and Japonic (Japanese) are unrelated tongues that share a cultural/writing sphere. Members: Jinxian (Chinese, civ), Yamataian (Japanese, clan), and the Sino-Japanese blend Ryujin (civ). DEITY MODEL = independent (user choice C): Chinese morphs the canon into Sinitic celestial names; Japanese keeps wholly NATIVE kami, unrelated to the Chinese forms; the blend Ryujin syncretizes both (honji-suijaku: one power, two faces). Base provides the concept inventory, morphology template, the (areal/borrowed) shared roots, both title-ladder structures, and BOTH theonym sets. Orthography is ASCII romanization (pinyin-style for Sinitic; Hepburn-style for Japonic; tones/macrons dropped).

phonology.palette: Two distinct phonologies under one areal roof.

sub_palette_notes.sinitic: Chinese: monosyllabic morphemes; syllable (C)(G)V(C) with only -n/-ng codas; tones (unmarked in data); NO consonant clusters; surname(1) + given(1-2); celestial titles -di (emperor), -jun (lord), -wang (king).
sub_palette_notes.japonic: Japanese: open CV moras (only coda -n); five vowels a i u e o; pitch accent; no clusters; rendaku (sequential voicing) in compounds; clan(-shi/uji) + given; kami honorifics -no-kami, -no-mikoto, -hime.

phonology.phonotactics: Sinitic: tight monosyllables, no clusters. Japonic: strict CV moras, vowel-final.

lexicon_concepts._note: Same concept inventory as the other family bases; realized separately per sub-palette (the two tongues do NOT share vocabulary except where Japanese borrowed Sino-readings).

shared_roots._note: AREAL, not genetic: these are Sino-Japanese BORROWINGS (one written glyph, a Chinese reading and a Japanese on'yomi reading). They are the only cross-tongue link in the family.

theonym_sets._note: TWO INDEPENDENT sets (user choice C). Sinitic = canon morphed into Chinese celestial names (used by Jinxian, the Chinese side of Ryujin, and cross-blends Serican/Xiongan). Japonic = wholly native kami, NOT borrowed from the Chinese (used by Yamataian, the Japanese side of Ryujin, and cross-blend Shidhean). Ryujin (the blend) identifies the two as one power under two faces (honji-suijaku). None are real Chinese/Japanese gods.

morphology_template.patronymic_form: Sinitic: surname(xing)-first, no patronymic particle; lineage (zu). Japonic: clan(uji/-shi)-first, X-no-Y linking; house (-ke).
morphology_template.gendered_endings: Sinitic: by auspicious meaning, no grammatical gender. Japonic: m -ro/-suke/-maru, f -ko/-e/-hime.
morphology_template.compounding_rule: feature/quality + type; Sinitic Jin-cheng (golden-city), Japonic Kuro-yama (black-mountain, rendaku -> -gawa etc.).

title_ladder_structure._note: ACKS 7 tiers, two modes. Sinitic civ (Jinxian, Ryujin): the five peerages (gong/hou/bo/zi/nan) under wang (king) and huangdi (emperor), Mandate of Heaven. Japonic clanhold (Yamataian): daimyo houses under shogun and the reigning tenno. Ryujin uses sinicized Sino-Japanese court titles (o = king, tei = emperor). Tier->ruler-level mapping pending the ACKS lookup.

conventions.people_name_default: Sinitic: surname + given (+ courtesy-name zi). Japonic: clan + given (+ adult/art name). Order family-first in both.
conventions.transparent_vs_opaque: moderate; many names are transparent meaning-compounds.
